name: kai-research
description: Token-tiered deep-research pipeline (the Researcher hire from agents_swarm): /kai-research plans in the expensive main-thread model and fans out capped Haiku/Sonnet subagents via deterministic workflows. Two modes — research a hard problem into a decision report, or sweep a known list with the same question per item into caller-schema records. Evidence lands on disk; synthesis never leaves the main thread. Replaces judgment-based orchestration (/o) with code-enforced budgets.
